ReadMe.Statement: DRAFT v0.1 — the technical layer's METAMODEL REGISTRY: the executable twin of 'Content Descriptions Level 1' in the AIVIA Design Document. The DOC is the design authority; this registry is what code and tests will consume. Protocol rule: any doc change to L1 updates this registry in the same breath.
Sunny, 2026-09-04 design session (doc); this workbook transcribed by Claude the same night at her request.

ALL CLOSED as of 2026-09-05: grain ruled opportunistic (field-calibrated); extract format = CONTRACT_DATALOAD (complete, v0.1 file format pinned by F1); containment direction ratified (references point toward stability, containment parent->child).

Node_Types.Required: no — RULING APPLIED at conversion (A1 refined 2026-09-05): the db is minted from the DBA registration prerequisite, never extract-derived; no extract description exists at minting. An org-supplied description may supersede later through the normal lifecycle.

no — CORRECTION APPLIED at conversion (caught by CHECK-TL-4 over the F1 build, 2026-09-05): the ratified contract has no schema-description extract part (§3: schema arrives as the per-table containment field) and the F1 answer key's schema nodes carry none. The draft row contradicted both ratified artifacts.

Node_Types.Shape / allowed values: registered source system; declared in the registration prereq's SCHEMA MAPPING, never extracted; since A2 the first component of identity — never stored as a second field
Node_Types.Notes: one source per schema (source-inheritance rule); tables/columns inherit via containment

Node_Types.Shape / allowed values: ORDERED list, loaded from the source's declared pk metadata
Node_Types.Notes: Sunny's ruling 2026-09-05: declared data, never prose; the phrase rule + gap list retired; referential integrity at intake

Node_Types.Shape / allowed values: declared by grain phrase on core tables only; absent + gap-listed elsewhere, never guessed
Node_Types.Notes: RULING APPLIED at conversion: doc ratified grain opportunistic (field-calibrated 2026-09-04); register D11 CLOSED 2026-09-05. Supersedes the xlsx OPEN/tbd row.

Node_Types.Required: when documented — absence is a COUNTED documentation gap, never a refusal. CORRECTION APPLIED 2026-09-06 (sepsis shakedown): org-catalog columns arrive undescribed by construction — a vendor dictionary never documents the org's own tables; the ruled fallback posture (readable name + counted coverage gap) already acknowledged undocumented columns.

Node_Types.Shape / allowed values: STRUCTURED map {code: meaning} + as_of — never prose
Node_Types.Notes: dictionary-documented values only (ZC-style, org control_ tables); revisit trigger for value NODES = cross-column code identity
STEP 3 (v1.23.0, birth-edge law): actors minted on first act; birth edge = being acted-by (>=1 act)
machine actors — own kind, never persons

Edge_Types.Direction rationale: parent->child per the ratified two-part convention: CONTAINMENT points parent->child; REFERENCE points toward the more stable node (doc edge-direction convention, ratified 2026-09-05; register D13 CLOSED). Supersedes the xlsx 'unresolved' note.
FK side points at PK side — SQL's own REFERENCES direction; the stable node never changes when dependents arrive
Edge_Types.Properties: on: ORDERED list of [fk_column, pk_column] pairs (composite = more pairs, same single edge) · cardinality · as_of

Rules_to_Checks.Doc rule: single source of authority, per object
Rules_to_Checks.Named check(s): CHECK-TL-1 writer census; CHECK-TL-2 provenance totality
Rules_to_Checks.What the check asserts: TL-1: exactly one component (the extract builder) writes this layer — no other writer exists in the codebase. TL-2: every node/edge carries a registered extract id it derives from.
building twice from the same extracts yields a deep-equal graph; deleting the layer and rebuilding restores it exactly.
every node/edge validates against Node_Types/Edge_Types here — kinds, required properties, shapes (values is a map, pk_columns is an ordered list). Unknown kind = red.
enforced at protocol steps 1-2: a new node kind in this layer must cite its demonstrated need in the doc first.
a table without declared pk_columns appears in the counted gap list; nothing ever synthesizes a key.

6a (buildable now): a registered extract may not declare a join whose dependent side it does not own — an org extract declaring an epic->epic join is refused and counted. 6 (deferred): practiced joins from the logic layer compared against declared joins_to edges — a compliance finding, not a graph edit. Deferral reason: logic layer undesigned.
two sources claimed within one schema = red; the recorded trigger to push source down a level.

Rules_to_Checks.Named check(s): INTAKE-8 unregistered-db refusal; INTAKE-9 declared-vs-captured db agreement
Rules_to_Checks.What the check asserts: the db is a DBA-completed prereq, never extract-derived; extracts attach schemas downward into a pre-registered db only; the dba responsibility mints from the prereq
Rules_to_Checks.Fixture case(s): F1 (registration.json; both snapshots pass); an unregistered-db refusal case (fixture to author)

Rules_to_Checks.What the check asserts: every extracted table has >=1 declared pk row; violation = named refusal listing keyless tables
Rules_to_Checks.Fixture case(s): F1 (all 7 tables carry pk rows); keyless-table refusal fixture (to author, with the unregistered-db one)

Fixture_Cases.Input (authored synthetic extract): 1 db, 2 schemas (source epic + source org), 3 tables w/ descriptions + pk_columns, columns w/ descriptions, one ZC-style values map, 1 normal join, 1 composite join
Fixture_Cases.Expected output (authored answer): the full expected graph, hand-authored node by node, edge by edge (the answer key)

Fixture_Cases.Input (authored synthetic extract): one table with no declared pk
Fixture_Cases.Expected output (authored answer): table present; gap-list entry present; no invented key

Fixture_Cases.Input (authored synthetic extract): an org-source control_ table enumerating values for one of its columns
Fixture_Cases.Expected output (authored answer): values map filled on the org column, sourced from the org extract

Fixture_Cases.Input (authored synthetic extract): one schema whose extract claims two sources
Fixture_Cases.Expected output (authored answer): CHECK-TL-7 fires; build refuses or counts per ruling

Fixture_Cases.Input (authored synthetic extract): org extract declaring a join between two epic tables
Fixture_Cases.Expected output (authored answer): declaration refused + counted; no joins_to edge minted

Fixture_Cases.Input (authored synthetic extract): (arrives with the logic layer) estate SQL joining outside declared paths

Incremental_Intake.Definition: twin-graph ruling (2026-09-06) 2a/5a + CONTRACT_DATALOAD §13. Doc is authority.
on every KG1 object (db/schema/table/column): hash over the object's declared syntax + semantics as loaded
load stamp + source-snapshot identity on every object
intake diffs by hash; only changed objects write; unchanged hash writes nothing (INTAKE-13)
scheduled full parallel load compares against incremental state; any delta is a COUNTED finding (INTAKE-12), never silently reconciled
the changed-object set feeds object-grain staleness — only KG2b meaning nodes whose draws_from cite a changed object retranslate
